scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Go to the very top floor of the Geffen Tower, there will be a Cat you need to talk to. He will ask you to go to the Prontera Knight Guild.
1.short_ru: Поговорите с Cat на вершине Geffen Tower; затем идите в Prontera Knight Guild.
1.short_en: Talk to Cat at the top of Geffen Tower, then go to Prontera Knight Guild.
1.full_ru: Поднимитесь на самый верхний этаж Geffen Tower и поговорите с Cat. Он отправит вас в Prontera Knight Guild.
1.full_en: Go to the very top floor of the Geffen Tower, there will be a Cat you need to talk to. He will ask you to go to the Prontera Knight Guild.

2.original_instruction: In the Knight Guild, located in northwest Prontera, you'll need to introduce yourself to Simon Meyas.
2.short_ru: В Knight Guild на северо-западе Prontera поговорите с Simon Meyas.
2.short_en: Talk to Simon Meyas in the Knight Guild in northwest Prontera.
2.full_ru: В Knight Guild на северо-западе Prontera представьтесь Simon Meyas.
2.full_en: In the Knight Guild, located in northwest Prontera, you'll need to introduce yourself to Simon Meyas.

3.original_instruction: Return to the highest floor of the Geffen Tower again, with specific items: | 10 Crystal Blue | 10 Green Live | 10 Red Blood | 10 Wind of Verdure
3.short_ru: Вернитесь в Geffen Tower с 10 Crystal Blue, 10 Green Live, 10 Red Blood и 10 Wind of Verdure.
3.short_en: Return to Geffen Tower with 10 Crystal Blue, 10 Green Live, 10 Red Blood and 10 Wind of Verdure.
3.full_ru: Вернитесь на самый верхний этаж Geffen Tower с материалами: 10 Crystal Blue, 10 Green Live, 10 Red Blood, 10 Wind of Verdure.
3.full_en: Return to the highest floor of the Geffen Tower again, with specific items: | 10 Crystal Blue | 10 Green Live | 10 Red Blood | 10 Wind of Verdure

npcs.evidence: Go to the very top floor of the Geffen Tower, there will be a Cat you need to talk to. He will ask you to go to the Prontera Knight Guild.

reviews.detail: Cat and Simon Meyas are distinct contacts. One four-material set belongs to the return stage. Neither NPC has numeric coordinates in this guide; the final completion sentence does not identify a separate teacher or create a second material hand-in.
